sentences: Receipts and invoices get forged. After Q-Day, ECDSA signatures can be forged too.
QoreSign Receipt Guard signs each receipt with secp256k1 and ML-DSA-87, and anchors it on QoreChain.
The browser builds a canonical receipt and its SHA-256 fingerprint.
The wallet signs it twice: a classical signature and a post-quantum one.
A hybrid-signed transaction puts the fingerprint on chain, in the memo.
A verifier built on QoreSign then checks everything against the public chain.
This is the web app on testnet. For this recording the QoreX wallet is mocked: a local test key signs through the QoreChain SDK, but the transaction is real.
We fill in an invoice for 250 fUSD and sign. The signature is hybrid, with a 4,627-byte ML-DSA-87 part.
Then a hybrid-signed transaction anchors the fingerprint.
The verifier passes all seven checks, including the key registered on chain and a verified ML-DSA-87 layer.
Anyone can check a proof card. Here the amount is changed from 250 to 2,500.
Verified again, the fingerprint, signature and memo checks fail.
The same flow runs from the command line, using the SDK's hybrid EthNativeSigner.
This account's ML-DSA-87 key is registered on chain.

sentences.text: A fresh issue signs, anchors and verifies a new receipt, and all seven checks pass.

sentences: No app is needed to check it.
The public REST API returns the transaction with our memo, and a pqc_hybrid_verify event with status verified.
Sixteen offline tests cover edited receipts, a forged issuer, a wrong ML-DSA key, and a stripped post-quantum half: the downgrade case.
Three read-only live tests run against testnet on demand.
The ML-DSA-87 half is checked against the key registered on chain, never a key sent by the page.
Stripped post-quantum signatures and a wrong key are rejected, covered by unit tests.
Any edit to the receipt fails the fingerprint, signature and memo checks.
The anchor must be a committed transaction, signed by the issuer.
It also needs a verified ML-DSA-87 layer.
Built with create-qorechain-dapp, the QoreChain SDK, QoreSign, and the QoreX wallet interface.
MIT licensed, testnet only. Build Before Q-Day.
